I am a geoinformatics professional with about 4 years experience ranging from environmental monitoring to public health. With a masters in GeoData Science, my work falls in the intersection of artificial intelligence and Earth Observation. 

My goal is to build practical solutions for real-world environmental problems and as such I am also interested in trustworthy GeoAI and combining domain knowledge with machine learning models to ensure not only accuracy but reliable in practice. 

Feel free to look through my work at the Projects or Activities tab. If our interests align, I’d love to connect!
